Tile names, sizes and finishes as supplied for the sale. Colours on screen can differ from the tile, so see it in person before you buy.

Why come on the day

Four reasons to be there early

  • $5

    Tiles from $5 per m²

    Clearance floor tiles start from $5 per m², and every line is priced to clear. Ask the team for the price of the tile you like.

  • Wholesale to the public

    No trade account needed. Renovators, landlords and builders all buy at the same sale prices.

  • BBQ on site

    The barbecue is on from the morning. Bring the family, grab something to eat and take your time choosing.

  • Final lines

    These lines will not be restocked. When the last box of a tile sells, it is gone, so buy enough for the whole job in one visit.

The price

How the $5 per m² clearance pricing works

Clearance floor tiles start from $5 per m². Each line is priced on its own, so ask the team for the price of the tile you like. If you have been hunting for cheap floor tiles in Sydney, this is the place to start.

It is a tile sale for Sydney renovators working to a budget, and it runs only while these lines last. Looking for discount tiles in Sydney for a rental, a garage or a whole house? Bring your measurements and ask what is left.

What is included

What is in the clearance

This is our tile clearance: final lines of tiles that we are selling through. The tiles above are some of the lines going out for the Car Park Sale. What is left changes as lines sell out, so call before you make a special trip for one tile.

How is the clearance different from the regular tile range?

Clearance floor tilesRegular tile range
PriceFrom $5 per m²Priced ranges from $16 to $40 per m²
Where to buyIn the Bonnyrigg showroom, and at the Car Park Sale on Saturday 12 DecemberIn the showroom, or add to an enquiry on this site
RestockedNo. Final linesYes, the ranges continue

Clearance pricing applies only to the lines our showroom team identifies as clearance.

If you want the regular range instead, see the floor tiles or browse our full tile range.

Availability

Final lines: once they are gone, they are gone

Clearance lines will not be restocked. When the last box of a tile sells, that tile is finished, and we cannot order more to match.

That matters for a floor. Buy enough for the whole area in one visit, with extra for cuts, because a second trip may find the line sold.

Visit us

Come to the Bonnyrigg showroom on the day

Showroom: 43-45 Bonnrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg NSW 2177. The Car Park Sale runs on Saturday 12 December from 7am to 3pm. On other days we are open Monday to Friday 7am to 5pm and Saturday 7am to 3pm, and closed on Sundays.

Bring your room measurements and, if you are taking tiles home the same day, a vehicle that can carry the weight. Plan your trip on the Bonnyrigg showroom page for directions and loading details.

Terms

Clearance terms: quantities and returns

Clearance tiles are sold from the stock on hand, so the quantity of each line is limited. Tell the team your square metres and they will check whether there is enough of one tile for the job.

Ask about returns before you pay. Our sales terms and conditions set out how returns work, and because clearance lines are not restocked, we cannot swap a tile for more of the same once it has sold out.

Laying and care

Laying and caring for clearance tiles

Clearance tiles are laid like any other tile. Your tiler will want the right adhesive for the tile and the surface under it, so ask us about adhesive for porcelain and large format tiles when you buy.

Once laid, sweep regularly and mop with a pH neutral cleaner. Keep a few spare tiles, because a clearance line cannot be reordered for repairs.

Car Park Sale

Car Park Sale questions

When is the Car Park Sale?

Saturday 12 December, from 7am to 3pm, at our Bonnyrigg showroom. There is a BBQ on site on the day.

How much are the clearance tiles?

Clearance tiles start from $5 per m². Each line has its own price, and the team will tell you the price of any tile on the day.

Is the sale open to the public?

Yes. The Car Park Sale is wholesale to the public, so you do not need a trade account.

Will clearance lines be restocked?

No. These are final lines. Once a tile has sold out it will not be restocked.

Can I reserve a tile before the sale?

Add the tile to your enquiry or call (02) 8786 0288, and the team will check how much is left. Quantities are limited to the stock on hand.

Where is the sale?

At our one showroom, in Bonnyrigg. Showroom: 43-45 Bonnrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg NSW 2177.

Can clearance tiles be returned?

Ask the team before you buy. Returns are covered by our sales terms and conditions, and a sold out clearance line cannot be exchanged for more of the same tile.

mainEntity.name: When is the Car Park Sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: Saturday 12 December, from 7am to 3pm, at our Bonnyrigg showroom. There is a BBQ on site on the day.

mainEntity.name: How much are the clearance tiles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clearance tiles start from $5 per m². Each line has its own price, and the team will tell you the price of any tile on the day.

mainEntity.name: Is the sale open to the public?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Car Park Sale is wholesale to the public, so you do not need a trade account.

mainEntity.name: Will clearance lines be restocked?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. These are final lines. Once a tile has sold out it will not be restocked.

mainEntity.name: Can I reserve a tile before the sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add the tile to your enquiry or call (02) 8786 0288, and the team will check how much is left. Quantities are limited to the stock on hand.

mainEntity.name: Where is the sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: At our one showroom, in Bonnyrigg. Showroom: 43-45 Bonnrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg NSW 2177.

mainEntity.name: Can clearance tiles be returned?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ask the team before you buy. Returns are covered by our sales terms and conditions, and a sold out clearance line cannot be exchanged for more of the same tile.
